name: hcapp_checkConnection
description: Connectivity ping endpoint. Returns a hardcoded 'Connected' string. Both parameters are accepted but never read, validated, or used.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Device identifier. Accepted but never used — dead input.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Auth token. Accepted but never validated — no auth guard on this SP whatsoever.

rowsets.name: ConnectionResult
rowsets.description: Single hardcoded row returned on all calls.

codeSmells.detail: @deviceId and @accessToken are accepted but never read or validated. Any caller can invoke this SP without a valid token. Unlike every other app SP, there is no CHECK_ACCESS_TOKEN_V2 guard. Whether this is intentional (unauthenticated ping) or an oversight is undocumented.
Acceptable for a trivial read-only SP that cannot fail, but inconsistent with HC6 standards.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
